# Retrom GBA smoke ROM

`gba-smoke.gba`, `pegasus-smoke.gba`, and `emulationstation-smoke.gba` are
project-owned Game Boy Advance programs used only by Retrom's product E2E
tests. They contain no third-party
game, firmware, vendor logo, SDK output, or other proprietary payload. The three
ROMs execute the same program but carry distinct project-owned GBA header
identities, so the ordinary upload, Pegasus directory, and EmulationStation
directory flows can run in one isolated database without duplicate-content
short-circuiting any product path.

`gamelist.xml` is the minimal strict EmulationStation catalog consumed with
`emulationstation-smoke.gba`. It references only that adjacent project-owned ROM,
`emulationstation-smoke-cover.png`, and `emulationstation-smoke-video.webm`; it
contains no host path or third-party metadata.

The 70×98 PNG cover is assembled byte-for-byte by `build_cover` from a
project-designed purple, dark-blue, and turquoise geometric pattern. The
one-second 160×112 VP8/WebM preview contains only the same project-designed
flat-color geometry. Its canonical project-owned encoded payload lives in
`build.py`, so regeneration does not depend on a system encoder, external
download, vendor logo, or third-party media. Both files are deliberately
distinct CAS payloads and let the product E2E prove the EmulationStation media
handoff, publication, access, and release boundaries.

`gba-smoke-cover.png` and `gba-smoke-video.webm` are the corresponding media
for the ordinary upload flow. The cover uses a separate project-designed
palette, while the video carries a valid playback-neutral EBML Void element.
That makes both ordinary-upload assets byte-distinct from the EmulationStation
assets and lets deletion tests prove that the latter ROM, cover, and video all
become unreferenced without weakening shared-CAS protection.

Each ROM boots directly in ARM state without a BIOS, selects GBA video mode 3,
draws a high-contrast framebuffer, and alternates the top ten scanlines between
red and green once per frame. Holding the GBA A button changes that animated
band to blue. This gives the browser tests deterministic frame, image, input,
and save-state signals while still exercising the real mGBA core.

The deliberately blank vendor-logo area means these 1 KiB images target
BIOS-free emulator execution and are not intended to boot on physical hardware.

Regenerate and verify it with:

```bash
python3 testdata/public-roms/gba-smoke/build.py
python3 testdata/public-roms/gba-smoke/build.py --check
```

`build.py` is the sole source of truth. The generated ROMs, catalog, covers,
and videos must be byte-identical on every supported host. The source and
every generated byte are licensed under the adjacent MIT license.
